# thermoforming
# Baseline of buildCommodityRules — DO NOT hand-edit.

### context: full
THERMOFORMING COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  materialId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  method: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  formedWallMm=3  [ray-cast mean wall of the formed part — deterministic, use verbatim]
  sheetThicknessMm: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  drawRatio=0.4  [96 mm depth ÷ 240 mm smallest opening — deterministic, use verbatim]
  partWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  sheetWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  heatTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  coolTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  formTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  trimTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  projectedAreaCm2=768  [two largest bounding-box dimensions — deterministic, use verbatim]
  mouldMaterial: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  toolCostGBP: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  energyKwhPerKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
  formability: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HIPS (High Impact PS) | ABS | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12) | Rigid PVC (uPVC pipe grade) | PC (Lexan))
